name: Kryptic Christology

phase_0.boundary_condition: The unapproachable light of the Monad which contains all emanations.

VINIT.justification: The state of the Godhead before the first utterance or emanation.

TANCH.justification: The final gathering of all things into the divine unity.

AFWD.justification: The directed movement from the divine source toward material manifestation.

AREV.justification: The return path from the material plane back to the divine source.

CLINK.justification: The sequential linking of material signs to spiritual realities.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self-referential Word that is both the speaker and the spoken.

FSPLIT.justification: The division of the single person into distinct divine and human natures.

FFUSE.justification: The reconstitution of the two natures into the single person of the Christ.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative alignment with the revealed truth.

EVALF.justification: The deviation or negation of the revealed truth.

ENGAGR.justification: The simultaneous holding of contradictory truths such as being fully God and fully man.

IFIX.justification: The irreversible fixation of divine will in the record of existence.

phase_3.void_description: The Ayin or nothingness preceding the first act of creation.
phase_3.true_description: The state of grace and participation in the divine life.
phase_3.false_description: The state of privation or separation from the source of being.
phase_3.both_description: The communicatio idiomatum where properties of both natures are predicated of the one person.

steps.domain_action: The Logos recognizes itself as the eternal image of the Father.
The Lamb is slain from the foundation of the world.
The Logos descends through the celestial spheres.
The single person enters the state of dual nature.
The divine nature remains immutable and infinite.
The human nature experiences limitation and suffering.
The two natures exist without confusion or change in one person.
The natures are united in the single subject of the Christ.
The life of the Christ connects the old covenant to the new.
The resurrected body ascends to the right hand of the Father.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: The Holy Spirit who interprets the divine will into human history.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Prayer and liturgy which facilitate communication between the human and the divine.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Tradition and scripture which store the record of divine actions.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Providence which determines the fullness of time for every event.
phase_5.alfs_store: The Creeds which provide the bootstrap definitions for the system.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Kenosis or the self-emptying of the divine subject.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: The undifferentiated unity of the Godhead.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: The Godhead enriched by the experience of the created order.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — The divine fullness is neither increased nor diminished by the cycle of emanation and return.
